name: comp-358
title: Icon Rich Tooltip
blurb: A tooltip with an icon and title/body text laid out horizontally.
description: Dark tooltip displaying an icon on the left and multiline text content (title and description) on the right.
use_when: Tooltips that need visual iconography alongside explanatory text.
avoid_when: Small screens or narrow containers where icon+text layout breaks.
a11y: Button is fully accessible; icon is marked aria-hidden as decorative; tooltip is shown via hover only.
